A clearer view of the week.

Plan plant care checks, fertilising, pruning and repotting with a personal care calendar.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

What belongs in a care calendar?

Use it for soil checks, observations and tasks you choose. Refer to reliable species-specific guidance and product labels when considering fertilisers or treatments.

Record what happened

A useful calendar connects planned tasks with completion history. It helps you see your routine without implying that every completed task improves plant health.

Built for real routines

FloraTend's calendar is being developed alongside recurrence and timezone handling. Final supported behaviour will follow verified app release checks.
